items:
Ocean by Royal Destinations

Location: Gulf Front Community South Seacrest Beach
Address: 41 Elysee Court

Details:
Searching for a luxurious 30A rental for your next escape? Ocean seamlessly blends classic design with a modern flair, showcasing stunning architecture throughout the home. Every aspect of this 30A vacation rental has been meticulously crafted to impress. Featuring 5 bedrooms and 6 bathrooms across 3 floors, Ocean comfortably accommodates up to 16 guests. While the gourmet kitchen and spacious living areas are impressive, there are also plenty of cozy spots for some personal downtime in this luxurious vacation rental. If you're in the market for 30A rentals with private pools, you’ll be thrilled with the second-floor pool conveniently located just off great room. As you enter the gated, gulf-front community, you'll quickly realize this neighborhood stands out from the rest along 30A. With exclusive access to a private community beach, you can truly savor the luxury of Santimo. Nestled between Alys and Rosemary Beach, Ocean is just a short stroll or bike ride away from fantastic shopping and dining options. For those seeking vacation rentals on 30A, exquisite luxury and a relaxed lifestyle await you at Ocean.

If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental.

Home Highlights:
- Tesla Charging Station in Garage
- Distance to Beach Access: 35 yards
- Parking Spaces: 2 in Driveway + 2 in Garage
- Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 18 and Bar Seating for 4
- Nespresso and Coffee Maker Available
- Gulf Views
- Fourth Floor Viewing Tower
- Private Heated Pool: 10’ x 20’
*Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax).
*The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees.
*Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay.

Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements:
Sleeps: 16
5 Bedrooms + Bunkroom/ 5 Baths + Half Bath

First Floor:
- Bedroom 1: King Bed
- Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower)
- Bunkroom: (2) Twin over Twin bunks
- Hall Bathroom with Dual Vanity Sinks and shower/tub combo
- Laundry

Second Floor:
- Bedroom 3 (En Suite): (2) Queen Beds with Private Bath (Shower)
- Gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, wet bar, and pantry
- Open concept main living room with views of the pool deck
- Balcony with private pool, chaise lounge chairs, and bar stool seating
- Media space with cozy seating
- Half Bath

Third Floor:
- Bedroom 4 (Grande Suite): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower and Soaking Tub), office space/yoga room
- Bedroom 5: King Bed with Private Bath and walk-in Shower
- Media space with comfortable seating
- Laundry
- Spiral Staircase to Tower

Amenities Include:
- 6 Adult Bikes
- Beach Towel Service
- Two Beach Chairs and One Umbrella Guaranteed March-October (Complimentary second beach set may be available depending on availability.)

Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
